documentInfo.description: Valid: the analytics module uses a secondary prefix 'exp' for http://example.com/common, which collides with the importing model's 'exp' for http://example.com/financials. The URI http://example.com/common is not in the importing model's namespace map so implicit resolution is impossible. prefixRemap { 'cmn': 'exp' } is required: it registers 'cmn' → http://example.com/common in the importing model and re-prefixes exp:CommonMetric to cmn:CommonMetric in the compiled result.
